title.purpose: Feature/service names, panel and inspector headings.

label.purpose: Mono uppercase group headlines and micro-labels (0.55-0.62rem).

mono.purpose: Figures, references, endpoints, JSON payloads, timestamps.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for panels, rows, service cards, and the profile switcher (light).

shadows.name: panel-sm
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift for nav/profile active state and service cards at rest.

shadows.name: night-highlight
shadows.purpose: Hairline top highlight that lifts surfaces off the charcoal ground where drop shadows don't register.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: rows, cards, and tiles settle in (fade + 5px rise, ~180ms). No departures-board flips, no glows.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: 120-160ms background/border/color transitions on hover, focus, and selection; service cards add a 2px translateY lift on hover.

extensions.reducedMotion: All settle animations and the card hover lift are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.css: .ds-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;border:1px solid #d8d1c3;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:#faf7f0;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(39,33,22,.06);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .14s ease,box-shadow .14s ease,border-color .14s ease}.ds-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(39,33,22,.08),0 8px 24px rgba(39,33,22,.08);border-color:#c2b9a7}.ds-card__top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:16px 16px 0}.ds-card__badge{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:8px;background:#f1ede3;border:1px solid #d8d1c3;color:#585a54;transition:color .14s ease,border-color .14s ease}.ds-card:hover .ds-card__badge{color:#1b1e22;border-color:#c2b9a7}.ds-card__status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 9px;border:1px solid #c2b9a7;border-radius:999px;background:#f1ede3;color:#1d7a4b;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-card__lamp{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:999px;background:currentColor}.ds-card__body{flex:1;padding:13px 16px 16px}.ds-card__name{display:block;font-family:'Public Sans',sans-serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#1b1e22;line-height:1.3}.ds-card__gloss{display:block;font-family:'Public Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.8rem;color:#585a54;line-height:1.5;margin-top:5px}.ds-card__foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:11px 16px;border-top:1px solid #d8d1c3;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.62rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8a857a;transition:color .14s ease}.ds-card:hover .ds-card__foot{color:#8a5e0f}.ds-card__arrow{transition:transform .16s ease}.ds-card:hover .ds-card__arrow{transform:translateX(3px)}

narrative.overview: Valedorsinho is read like a settlement day-book: a payment is a conversation between the merchant server, the shopper, and Adyen, and the interface exists to make that conversation legible and reconcilable. Surfaces are ruled, tabular, and quiet — ink on warm paper by day, lamplit warm charcoal by night. Gold is the single bright mark and means only 'active/selected'; red is spent only on exceptions. It deliberately replaces the project's legacy terminal/cyberpunk identity, which is an anti-reference.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper (light) and warm charcoal (dark) duality; no cool/blue grounds.
Gold is the sole active/selection accent; red is reserved for exceptions.
Public Sans everywhere, JetBrains Mono for figures, endpoints, and JSON.
Dense, hairline-ruled, tabular surfaces with zebra separation in long logs.
Quiet 'settle' motion only — no departures-board theatrics, no glows.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold means 'active/selected' and nothing else. If two things on a screen are gold, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Red-for-Exceptions Rule
rules.body: Red is only ever a refusal, error, or broken reconciliation — never decoration or a party color.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Measurement Rule
rules.body: Monospace is only for code, data, endpoints, references, and labels — never as a 'technical' costume on prose.

rules.name: The No-Signage Rule
rules.body: No condensed, all-caps signage display lettering. Headlines are Public Sans.

rules.name: The Dark-Needs-a-Highlight Rule
rules.body: On charcoal, pair every lifted surface with a 1px top highlight; a drop shadow alone is invisible.

dos: Do use gold only for active/selected chrome and keep it to a small fraction of the screen.
Do keep red exclusively for exceptions.
Do render figures, references, endpoints, and JSON in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
Do separate dense lists with hairlines + zebra and stack a bold label over its muted description.
Do convey depth on dark via a lighter tone + 1px top highlight, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't reintroduce the legacy terminal world: neon cyan/green, scan-lines, noise, or glows.
Don't use amber/green/red as glowing traffic-light lamps, or cool/blue-black grounds.
Don't use condensed all-caps signage display type.
Don't truncate titles or endpoints in the registry — let them wrap.
Don't put a colored border-bar (>1px) on list items or cards (the side-tab tell).
Don't make webhook entries expandable in the registry.
